reconstruction_snippet: if (JAVA_SOUNDS || sound < 0 || sound > sound_count_) return; ... sounds_[sound] = ...
explanation: The listing (CMP R1,R3; BLE at 0x369A60) and the pseudocode both accept sound == sound_count_, so the original stores a new sound block at sounds_[sound_count] one past the end of the table. The port keeps the same bound (sound > sound_count_ returns), so it writes out of range too. Only reachable with an id equal to the count, so callers that pass valid ids are not affected. Suggest a bound of sound >= sound_count_ in the port, which is what UnloadSound (0x36921c) uses.
